title: Concordance Board: unified trace-log latency view (model/route, p50-p95-p99, stream vs blocking)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We currently have multiple dashboards that show latency percentiles by model/route and separate trace links, but it's hard to correlate slow p99 spikes with trace-level root causes and whether the request was streaming or blocking. This creates long debug loops between runtime, traces, and the console.

Proposal: Build a "Concordance Board" — a new dashboard and supporting pipeline that joins span traces, request-level metrics, and sanitized logs to provide: model/route-level p50/p95/p99 with split-by I/O style (streaming vs blocking), direct trace links from percentile cohorts, per-cohort KV cache hit/miss rates, and aggregated downstream error signals. The board should support time-slicing, request-shape cohorting (prompt length, token output, streaming chunks), and an exportable CSV for incident triage.

Scope: front-end dashboard in Console, backend metrics aggregation job (k8s job + metrics pipeline), trace hook instrumentation updates to add request annotations (model, route, io_mode, kv_cache_hit), and log ingestion enrichment to attach request_id for joinability. This ticket covers the end-to-end pipeline and initial dashboard MVP for top 50 model routes.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard surfaces p50, p95, p99 latency for selected model/route and time range
Dashboard includes a split toggle: streaming vs blocking (non-streaming) with bars and time series overlays
Percentile cohorts link to sampled traces; clicking a cohort opens trace viewer focused on span waterfall
KV cache hit/miss percentage is shown alongside latency percentiles for cohort comparison
Logs and error counts for the cohort are accessible via a single-click drilldown (opens logs view filtered by request_id list)
Metrics pipeline runs within SLO (ingest latency < 90s) and backs the dashboard for 95% of queries
Documentation (Confluence) with usage guide, dashboard queries, and troubleshooting runbook is published
Unit and e2e tests added for trace enrichment and metric aggregator jobs
tasks: Add trace hook changes: annotate root span with model, route, io_mode, request_shape, kv_cache_hit (ENG runtime team review required)
Update logging ingest pipeline to persist request_id and io_mode tags into logs index
Create metric aggregation job that computes percentile cohorts and stores time-bucketed results in observability-store
Design and implement Concordance Board UI components (percentile table, split-by toggle, cohort trace links)
Wire trace viewer links with secure signed URLs for sampled traces
Add CSV export and incident snapshot endpoint
QA: synthetic load test for streaming vs blocking requests and validate percentile accuracy
Docs + runbook + announce in #observability and weekly infra sync
